description: This PHP class 'EmailsNonImportedDetailView' extends 'EmailsDetailView' and manages the display and population of email details for non-imported emails within the SuiteCRM system. It includes setup and populateBean methods, with logic to retrieve inbound email records and populate email data accordingly.

classes.name: EmailsNonImportedDetailView
classes.description: A class extending EmailsDetailView to handle non-imported email detail view logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the view with specific module, focus, metadata, template, and configuration.

methods.name: populateBean
methods.description: Populates the email bean with data based on request parameters, retrieving inbound email records and handling missing data.
